text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The race of my dreams is coming true!
Doto's first
G1 with Opera O... My oshis
are gonna run
together in a G1!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I know full well a little classic-year
pipsqueak like
me doesn't stand a
chance! But still... Even if
that's true...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm getting the best seat in the house!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital throws herself to the
ground and
grovels before taking on the
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Here they are... in the flesh. I-I-I'm
seeing them
with my own two eyes!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for this moment,
Doto! ♪ Come
at me with everything
you can muster!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I knew this would be a sacred event, but it's like all of my fantasies are coming true!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Which means today, I've got to run
serious
enough to do my fantasies
justice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Agnes Digital is going to show
everyone
just how good she can make
the other two look as
she runs.
